metadata_options.title: Sample metadata
metadata_options.description: A CSV describing the samples in this cohort. One row per sample. Only samples listed here are included in the analysis.

metadata.title: Sample metadata table
metadata.description: CSV uploaded to this project as a Files dataset. Must contain one column of VirScan sample IDs.

sample_id_column.title: Sample ID column
sample_id_column.description: The column holding the VirScan ID that matches the PhIP-Flow sample names, e.g. VS76_140.

participant_column.title: Participant ID column
participant_column.description: Optional. The column identifying the participant. Required for trajectory lines and for distinguishing a time variable from one recorded once per participant.

virus_annotations.title: Virus annotation table
virus_annotations.description: Optional CSV with an 'organism' column plus any columns grouping organisms into biologically meaningful sets.
